frequency_question: How often do central banks raise the CCyB above 0% outside of immediate post-crisis rule-writing phases?
membership_rule: Includes any jurisdiction with a Basel III framework that actively adjusted its CCyB rate above 0% during non-crisis equilibrium periods. Excludes the initial setup phase where the framework was merely being populated at 0%.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB Increase

provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 3 named (5.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named; believed roughly 15 comparable national regulatory cycles in total for this specific policy tool.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging markets whose capital frameworks diverge from standard Fed/BoE structures.
skeleton: Global G-SIB jurisdictions maintaining a Basel III framework evaluated over 5 major economic blocks across 3 distinct policy windows.
multiplier: 3 positive activations out of approximately 15 distinct structural opportunities among advanced economies over the relevant window.
validity_reason: Macroprudential regulatory baselines evolve slowly across structural regimes, remaining valid through the current Basel framework generation.
